Headline: #65 Grand Temporary Westbound Reroute near Grand/California
ShortDescription: Westbound 65 Grand buses are temporarily rerouted due to construction near Grand/California.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Westbound #65 Grand buses are temporarily rerouted via Grand, California. Chicago, Grand and over the regular route, due to construction near Grand/California.

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: Kimball-bound Brown Line Delays
ShortDescription: Kimball-bound Brown Line trains are running with residual delays following an earlier sick customer at Adams/Wabash. Service is resuming, allow extra time.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Kimball-bound Brown Line trains are running with residual delays following an earlier sick customer at Adams/Wabash.

Some trains and platforms may be busier than usual as crews work to restore normal service.

Trains are moving and normal service is being restored.

Allow extra travel time.
